The approximation of a non-linear volt-ampere characteristic of electric precipitator with the use of power function and function with condition is offered. The function with condition is applied also to approximation of resistance of the semiconductor diode for different polarities. The results of the research of a mathematical model of an electric precipitator are given in the form of oscillograms the shape of which coincides well with experimental curves. The research results can be useful in the development of regulated power sources of electric precipitators and other devices, because for making intellectual control systems of these devices it is necessary to know the exact description of the processes happening in them.

articleTitle: Information Component Recognition in Fault Signals for Relay Protection of Electric Grids with HVDC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The faults in AC network may cause commutation failure in adjacent inverter station of HVDC, accompanied by injection of DC line discharge current into AC network. In this case a significant number of transient components arises in emergency voltages and currents, which level is comparable with level of main harmonic. Conventional protection relays may miss-operate due to error in non-adaptive orthogonal component filters during processing of such signals. The implementation of adaptive signal processing algorithms for improving relay protection stability is studied. It's shown that improving of signal recognition require proper sampling rate and adaptive signal model order. An adaptive blocking algorithm preventing protection miss-operation in poor measurement conditions is suggested.

Author Keywords: adaptive structural analysis of power system signals

articleTitle: Vibration-Based Monitoring of Electrotechnical Systems of an Iron-and-Steel Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper emphasizes the importance of vibration-based monitoring of the technical condition of a metallurgical enterprise's equipment. Also, this paper presents a brief list of industrial facilities subject to vibration-based monitoring. Reasons for increased vibration of rotary equipment are described. The relevance of continuous vibration of the tank and body of the on-load tap changer body of electric furnace transformers is also emphasized. The paper provides a list of main vibration characteristics used to assess the technical condition of a facility. Also, charge pump vibration is analyzed and defects found. Conditions of a bearing and asynchronous motor were analyzed. Evolving defects confirmed during repair works were registered. The paper considers a method for vibration-based monitoring of oil pumps of the transformer's cooling system. Also, the paper provides results of assessing vibration on the electric furnace transformer's wall. Tolerable values of vibration parameters are given. The conclusion on the importance of vibration-based monitoring for identifying-at early stages-defects of electric and mechanical equipment was made.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control of Low-Power Brushless DC Motor Based on the Use of Back-EMF
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The method of sensorless control of brushless DC motor with permanent magnets at 120 degree switching of windings is proposed. To approximate the trapezoidal function of the back-EMF rotation, an approximation based on the piecewise linear function and the inscribed ellipse is proposed. This continuous function also has a continuous derivative, which is an advantage when modeling and calculating the switching moments of the motor windings. Switching of windings is made at equality of back-EMF of the switched-off and switched-on windings. The equations of electrical equilibrium of the motor windings are converted to a two-phase system. Switching moments are determined using a function that depends on the ratio of the back-EMF calculated for the transformed system. This function does not depend on the speed of rotation and can be used in a wide range of speeds. The start-up of BLDC with the subsequent transition to Sensorless control of switching of windings was investigated. The efficiency of the proposed method is confirmed by a computational experiment based on the simulation of a three-section brushless DC motor with permanent magnets.

articleTitle: Adaptive Force Control in Driven Equipment of Manipulator with Parallelogram Linkage
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper proposes a method of adaptive electromechanical force compensating system synthesis for a articulated balanced manipulator of the ShBM-150M type with elastic driven equipment in the form of anthropomorphic arm. It provides a mathematical description of electromechanical system with a compensator. The author obtained analytic equations for determining parameters of adaptive control device during change cargo mass and stiffness of mechanical transmissions. The controllability of manipulator mechanical part without the use of electric drive and the application of adaptive force control system in the driven equipment with a synthesized compensator during change moved cargo mass from 20 to 160 kg were analyzed.

articleTitle: Electric Drive System Study in Scientific and Educational Center “Schneider Electric - Nosov Magnitogorsk State Technical University”
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Transient processes of an induction motor stator current and voltage were registered by the digital protection device for a direct start and an idling regimes. The calculation algorithm was presented and instantaneous values of an active and reactive power, power losses, the magnetization curve, the main inductance of the motor and magnetic steel losses were calculated. The specified values were calculated on the induction motor computer model and the results of the experimental and simulated data were compared. The space-time wave MMF is built at idle according to the database of stator winding currents and magnetic core parameters. The resulting wave allows estimating the arisen high-frequency oscillations of the MMF in the gap between the stator and the rotor of the motor.

articleTitle: Extending Permissible Modes Band for Distributed Generation Units Under Voltage Dips in Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The causes and consequences of distributed generation units tripping by relay protection devices in the case of disturbances with voltage dips in adjacent power grid, are analyzed in the paper. It is proved, that relay protection settings for voltage drops without current control are not justified, due to the risk of thermal damage of generating units windings that occur in cases, where the multiplicity and / or duration of the stator or rotor overload exceeds the permissible values. It is substantiated in the paper that the nature of a transient process highly depends on the load composition and the resulting stability of AC electric motors in power district. The recommendations on using dynamic reactive power compensators for the purpose of distributed generation units permissible modes band extending, are presented. Based on the simulation results, the effectiveness of dynamic reactive power compensators for preventing generating units tripping during elimination of short-circuit faults by relay protection in adjacent power grid, is proved. The recommendations for determining a required value of reactive power injection as a function of the depth of voltage dip under short circuit and its duration, are given.

articleTitle: Combined Brillouin OFDA and Address FBG Sensor System for Distributed and Point Temperature Measurements
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper demonstrates a combined system that uses a Brillouin optical frequency domain analisys (BOFDA) for distributed temperature measurments and two point thermometers, based on address fiber Bragg gratings (AFBG), in order to monitor a power transmission line (PTL). The combined system makes it possible to carry out simultaneously distributed and accurate temperature measurements. The proposed circuit uses a conventional narrow-band optical source corresponding to a range of distributed temperature measurements. For point detection, two types of pass-through and reflecting types AFBGs are used. The width of a LD radiation band for AFBGs interrogation tightly corresponds to the temperature measurement range of the Bragg grating sensors with common Bragg wavelength. A common receiving module is used for both types of mesurements on the same sensor fiber. One AFBG consists from two identical ultra narrow FBGs with a unique address that was formed in them as symmetrical shift between Bragg wavelengthes of each FBG from average (reflecting type). Another AFBG consists from FBG with two identical phase π-shifts with a unique address that was formed as difference frequency between locations of given shifts (pass-through type). Distributed and point temperature can thus be measured in microwave frequency ranges, using microwave photonics approach, respectively: filtered on beating signal frequency between components of probing two-frequency radiation or on beating signal frequency between unique AFBG address components. Both beating frequencies lie separately in microwave frequencies range (~ tens GHz). Experimental data shows that temperature can be measured with little interference and higher resolution.

articleTitle: Technology of Electromagnetic Radiation Danger Presentation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article describes an approach to representing of electromagnetic radiation danger images: point-based projecting method and cylinder-based projecting method, and algorithms for creating the danger images for facilities where single or multiple electromagnetic fields components are active. To produce the images for cases when there are multiple simultaneously active electromagnetic field components in the same spatial zones, the influence estimations of these components have to be combined in some way. The article presents two ways of combining the estimations: the so-called “mechanic overlay method” and a method that is based on the selection of intersection of overlaying electromagnetic radiation influence zones. The second method is more complex but provides better results, because it is based on the existing normative documentation.

articleTitle: Improving Efficiency of Standalone Power Supply Systems Based on Virtual Power Plant Technologies
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Smart grid technologies can be used to increase the efficiency of standalone power supply systems. The article is devoted to the determination of the optimal topology of the electrical complex, combining several standalone power supply systems and operating on the virtual power plant principle. An algorithm for determining the electrical complex optimal topology, based on a graph theory and structural topological analysis, is developed. Theoretical and experimental research on the aggregation of three standalone power supply systems into a single electrical complex are carried out. The efficiency of the proposed algorithm is substantiated. A block diagram of an information exchange system is developed for the investigated electrical complex. The system provides for the exchange of data under the IEC 61850.

articleTitle: Insulators Electrical Strength Estimation under AC Applied Voltage
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents the main on-line technologies for insulators technical condition assessment in smart grid power supply systems, based on partial discharges characteristics analyses. The mechanism of solid insulation breakdown, caused by partial discharges, is described. A newly developed method of technical condition estimating of high voltage insulators had been compared with the traditional methods: the method of determining the ohmic resistance by a megger and the method of breakdown voltage. Furthermore, the method for separate recognition of PDs on the surface of polymer insulators from internal PDs is developed. The developed technology can be used for self-diagnosis of intelligent power supply systems.

Author Keywords: self-diagnosis of intelligent power supply systems

articleTitle: Algorithm for Asymmetric Control of Power Transistors in DC-DC Converter with Series-Resonant Inverter for Solar Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: DC-DC converters with series-resonant inverter (SRI) may arouse interest among scientists and converter equipment designers due to their applicability at solar power plants (SPP) in particular. Zero-current switching (ZCS) and/or zero-voltage switching (ZVS) of semiconductor devices could be easily implemented in such DC-DC converters. This could allow reducing power losses when switching devices considerably as well as operating DC-DC converters at higher frequencies with high efficiency. A basic diagram for the power section of the bridge DC-DC converter as well as the operating principle of this section in DC-DC converters with SRI for SPP is discussed in the Theory Section of the paper. There are a great number of analog control units on serial chips to control resonant DC-DC converters, but they are intended for symmetric control only. The paper provides a scheme for implementing the algorithm for asymmetric control of the resonant DC-DC converter power transistors on discrete components in the form of a virtual model in the Matlab/Simulink environment. So far, the asymmetric control method is described only in one foreign paper providing current oscilloscope patterns of the resonant circuit and control voltages across MOSFET transistor gates of the DC-DC converter as well as the control system flowchart. The experimental part of the article presents the simulation results (transient, steady state, external characteristics, dependences for the efficiency of the converter). The obtained characteristics are consistent with the results of theoretical calculations presented in previous papers of the authors.

articleTitle: Selection of Energy Storage Parameters in a Distributed Network and Control of its Operation Modes
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The development of the intellectual control system for SPENE-l energy accumulator is relevant technical and research issue. This system should ensure maximum efficiency of energy storage in power networks. The paper discusses the use of energy storage in distribution networks of an industrial enterprise and substantiation of the vector control method of the inverted synchronous motor of the energy storage SPENE-l. It presents a block diagram of the system of vector control of the energy accumulator motor and the results of its simulation in MatLab (Simulink). The work was financially supported by the Ministry of Science and Higher Education of the Russian Federation as part of the implementation of the Federal Target Program “Research and Development in the Priority Areas of the Development of the Scientific and Technological Complex of Russia for 2014-2020”, project identification number RFMEFI57818X0265 (agreement from 27.11. 2018, No 075-02-2018-209 (14.578.21.0265)).

articleTitle: Resistive Model of Synchronous Machines
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In case of a complex multi-machine electrical energy system (EES), the describing system equations have a large order if we take into account the system of automatic control of the excitation of generators, the order of the system of equations increases. Therefore, when solving such system equations, specific difficulties appear. However, the increased capabilities of modern computers and software, as well as the representation of differential equations in difference form, which allow replacing the conventional equivalent circuit of a synchronous machine (SM) with resistive (discrete) models, quickly eliminate the problems associated with the order of algebraic and even differential equations. The article discusses the use of a resistive model of a synchronous machine for further use in the study of transients. The advantage of the developed resistive model of a synchronous machine is that it allows one to perform a circuit equivalent of a group of k machines that exempt from logical operations with systems of equations.

articleTitle: Features of Linear Induction Motor Depended on Q-factor
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In this paper the effect of such parameter as a Q-factor on the speed/thrust characteristics and the degree of inductor current asymmetry of the linear induction motor (LIM) is considered. The problem is solved by 2D formulation by the finite element method and magnetic field is calculated on the basis of the Maxwell equations in the A-formulation. The influence of the transverse edge effect is taken into account by the Bolton's coefficient. As a result of the work, conclusions have been made about the degree of influence of Q-factor on the characteristics of the LIM and the correctness of application of Q-factor as an indicator of the economy and performance of the LIM.

articleTitle: Finding Electromagnetic Loads and Magnetic-Field Factors in Design of Integrated Brushless Excitation DC Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper covers the design of an integrated brushless excitation direct-current generator (IBEDCG), where the exciter and the main generator are located in the same magnetic system. When sizing the active part of such machines, one must choose and distribute the electromagnetic loads: magnetic flux density in the main-generator and exciter gap, and stator/rotor line current density. The research team investigated the magnetic-field factors (the estimated pole overlap factor, the form factor of the excitation flux and the EMF form factor) as a function of the exciter excitation winding design and magnetic-system saturation. The article compares the results of the FE simulation and analytical calculation of these coefficients. The suggestions on choosing the electromagnetic loads ratio of the exciter and the main generator are given. The paper provides specifications of a prototype generator for a special vehicle on tracks.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Two-Bridge Multi-Shouldered Adjustable Rectifier Unit Based on Transformer with Rotating Magnetic Field Equipped with Odd Section Count of Both Circular Windings
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents a short review of new class semiconductor converters based using the transformer with rotating magnetic field which is profitably differs from well-known designs via full geometric, electric and magnetic symmetry. The paper itemizes basic types of semiconductor converters which could be built using new power core and also reveals application spheres of these converters. A special attention is paid to the two-bridge multi-shouldered adjustable rectifier, its electric schematic diagram is shown, primary features of its design are described, its mathematic model built using MATLAB Simulink software is presented along with few notes regarding it commented. An analytical approach to the mathematical modeling of electromagnetic processes which are responsible to the electric energy transformation event is shown, the approach which guarantees the mathematic modeling of rectifier electrical installation in general to be correct entirely. The results of modeling 12 kW rectifier are shown alongside with its adjusting characteristic, output voltage curves, energetic efficiency ratio and ripple factor are calculated for nominal power mode and partial power modes alike.

articleTitle: Thermal Modes Analysis of Operation of Transformer with Rotating Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The basis of the research methods of thermal modes of the transformer with a rotating magnetic field is laid. The models are built in the ANSYS software. The article presents a brief description of the process of building a model on the example of a 6.5 kW transformer with trapezoidal and pear-shaped grooves. The parameters of the materials used in the model are given. The results of the study of the energy characteristics of a transformer with a rotating magnetic field are described. The thermal phenomena occurring in the structure of the transformer in the mode of operation under load are analyzed. On the basis of the obtained results of two-dimensional and three-dimensional modeling, temperature distribution graphs in the transformer structure are constructed on the example of internal and external magnetic cores. Conclusions are made about the nature of heating and heat distribution in the structure of a transformer with a rotating magnetic field with grooves of trapezoidal and pear shape. It is established that the additional heating of the external magnetic circuit, which does not contain windings, due to the transfer of energy from the internal magnetic circuit, is about 60%.

articleTitle: Development of Method for Photovoltaic Generation Control by Electrical Network Relative Power Losses Minimization Criteria
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In recent years, the world practice shows that in many In recent years, the world practice shows that in many developed countries the use of renewable energy sources has become an important factor for the sustainable development of their energy sector. The integration of solar power plants into the electric networks is one of the most important directions for the development of energy, but the issue of the influence of solar generation on the modes of electric distribution networks and the relative power loss is acute. This paper analyzes the effect of distributed solar generation on power losses and the configuration of the load curve. The problem of excessive solar generation at the weekend causes the flow of active power from the consumer to the power system, which leads to a change in the configuration of the load curve and an increase in the relative power losses. A calculation method is proposed to minimize relative power losses in electric networks, which allows improving the efficiency of the electric grid company in the conditions of integration of distributed solar generation. Also, to confirm the correctness of the calculation results of the proposed method, variational calculations were carried out.

articleTitle: Rectifier Drives for Delivery of Geophysical Devices in Directional and Horizontal Wells
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents a set of equipment for delivering geophysical instruments to a given point developed for geophysical research and exploration in horizontal sections of openhole directional wells. The delivery device is a controlled electromechanical device delivered into the well via a cable together with geophysical instruments and providing movement along a horizontal section with a given speed to a predetermined position. An integral part of an electromechanical device is a modular object-oriented rectifier drive that provides high reliability and specified motion parameters. One of the most important requirements for delivery devices is the reliability of the system. To improve the reliability, it is proposed to use the system of hot backup of the main units, namely: valve engines of the DBM series operating on one shaft and two power transistor converters.

articleTitle: Influence of Magnetic Field Attenuation on Linear Induction Motor Performance
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper examines the influence of attenuation of traveling-field magnetic wave over air thickness and conducting gap. The task of determining the distribution of magnetic field and integral values of forces is solved using finite element method in a two-dimensional formulation. The efforts are determined using the Lorentz and Maxwell approach. The averaged magnitudes of magnetic flux density along the x coordinate are given depending on the y component, namely, the thickness of the gap and the conducting layer of the secondary element. The subject of the study is a linear asynchronous motor conveyor transport for the transport of minerals. The influence of the frequency change on the attenuation of an electromagnetic wave in the air gap and the conducting layer of the secondary element and on the mechanical characteristics and pull forces is determined.

articleTitle: Simulation of Fault Mode in Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: There are a lot of different kinds of relay protection devices at the market. So, it is possible to implement different algorithms for protecting all types of grids, from small isolated grids to large regional power grids. The focus must be on early diagnosis of faults in power grids. Early diagnostic of single-phase ground faults allows improving values of SAIFI, SAIDI and CAIDI. The paper shows theoretical bases of a different kind of characteristics during the faults for early diagnostic. Voltage and current higher harmonics are used as the indicators of the faults in power grids. These indicators are universal for all types of grids, from a single line grid to a tree topology power grid.

articleTitle: Ensuring Reliable Operation of Electrical Network During ice Formation on Extra High Voltage Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The relevance of the topic of preventing ice-wind accidents in electrical networks is noted, and a feature of the organization of the ice melting system on extra high voltage (EHV) overhead transmission lines (OHL) is shown. The existing technical solutions for ice melting schemes on the phase wires and lightning protection rope of EHV OHL are listed, while problems are noted in covering the entire length of the circuit or in a specific local area in the middle of the route. Technical solutions are proposed for ice melting schemes on phase wires and lightning protection ropes of EHV OHL taking into account the latest achievements, in particular: the use of a high voltage thyristor ice melting switch on phase wires, thereby fully automating the process, application of the method of heating lightning protection ropes induced by currents from the phase operating currents (direct sequence), in the mode of power transmission over EHV OHL.

Author Keywords: coefficient of effectiveness of ice melting scheme
preventive heating of lightning protection rope

articleTitle: Evaluating Efficiency of Methods for Automatic Orientation Solar Panel Batteries to Position with Maximum Output Electrical Power
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper considers the main methods of automatic orientation of solar panel batteries perpendicular to the flow of solar radiation. The attention is focused on the problem of using solar energy and the economic efficiency of using stationary installation solar panel batteries. The output power by a stationary solar battery and a batteries subjected to two-axial orientation is calculated. The description is given of the experimental swivel installation. Experimentally determined the power of a two-axis swivel installation, spent for horizontal and vertical rotation at a given angle. Possible tracking algorithms for finding the optimal point for orienting a solar panel battery are considered. Based on the data obtained, the optimal positioning algorithm is determined and its economic efficiency is evaluated in comparison with a stationary battery. In addition, the system payback period is estimated.

articleTitle: Proceedings 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: power supply quality; power engineering computing; solar power stations; electric drives; stators; machine control; power grids; renewable energy sources; relay protection; power transmission lines.
